title: Full-Stack Engineer Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to solidify core fundamentals, master full‑stack technologies, build a showcase portfolio, and prepare for job or freelance success. Each phase blends learning, hands‑on building, and reflection to accelerate real‑world readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Reinforce core programming concepts and essential web fundamentals.

milestones.title: JavaScript & TypeScript Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Write clean, type‑safe JavaScript/TypeScript code for front‑end and back‑end tasks.

tasks.title: Read TypeScript Handbook basics
tasks.description: Study the official TypeScript handbook sections on types, interfaces, and generics.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp ES6 module
tasks.description: Finish the ES6+ module exercises on freeCodeCamp to practice modern syntax.

tasks.title: Convert a JS snippet to TS
tasks.description: Take a small JavaScript function you wrote before and add full TypeScript annotations.

tasks.title: Reflect on type errors
tasks.description: Write a short note on the most common type errors you encountered and how you fixed them.

milestones.title: SQL Basics & Data Modeling
milestones.outcome: Design simple relational schemas and run queries against a SQL database.

tasks.title: Watch SQL basics on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Watch the introductory videos covering tables, primary keys, and SELECT statements.

tasks.title: Create a SQLite DB for a todo list
tasks.description: Define tables for users, tasks, and tags, then populate with sample data.

tasks.title: Write CRUD queries
tasks.description: Implement SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE queries for the todo schema using the SQLite CLI.

tasks.title: Document schema decisions
tasks.description: Write a brief schema diagram and explain why you chose each relationship.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Gain proficiency in a modern front‑end framework and a back‑end runtime.

milestones.title: React (or Next.js) Mastery
milestones.outcome: Build interactive UI components and handle client‑side routing.

tasks.title: Follow Next.js tutorial on official docs
tasks.description: Complete the “Create a Next.js app” tutorial to understand pages, routing, and API routes.

tasks.title: Build a reusable Card component
tasks.description: Create a styled Card component with props for title, image, and actions.

tasks.title: Implement client‑side data fetching
tasks.description: Use getStaticProps or useEffect to fetch data from a mock API and display it.

tasks.title: Connect with a React community
tasks.description: Join the r/reactjs subreddit and introduce yourself, asking one question about state management.

tasks.title: Reflect on component patterns
tasks.description: Write a short note comparing functional vs class components and when to use each.

milestones.title: Node (or Django) Backend Development
milestones.outcome: Create RESTful APIs, handle authentication, and interact with a database.

tasks.title: Read Express.js guide on MDN
tasks.description: Study the MDN guide covering routing, middleware, and error handling in Express.

tasks.title: Build a simple CRUD API
tasks.description: Create endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todo items using Express and SQLite.

tasks.title: Add JWT authentication
tasks.description: Implement login, token issuance, and protected routes using jsonwebtoken library.

tasks.title: Watch Django tutorial on official docs
tasks.description: If you prefer Django, follow the “Writing your first Django app” tutorial to understand models and views.

tasks.title: Reflect on API design choices
tasks.description: Summarize why you chose REST over GraphQL for this project and note any trade‑offs.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio‑ready full‑stack projects that showcase end‑to‑end feature delivery.

milestones.title: SaaS Billing App Prototype
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate ability to integrate payments, user accounts, and a dashboard.

tasks.title: Plan app features on a whiteboard
tasks.description: Sketch user flows for signup, subscription management, and admin dashboard.

tasks.title: Set up Next.js front‑end with Stripe Checkout
tasks.description: Integrate Stripe’s Checkout component to handle subscription payments.

tasks.title: Create Node API for subscription data
tasks.description: Implement endpoints to store and retrieve user subscription status in PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Deploy to Vercel and Render
tasks.description: Push the front‑end to Vercel and the back‑end to Render, configuring environment variables.

tasks.title: Write project README
tasks.description: Document setup steps, tech stack, and key challenges solved.

milestones.title: Real‑Time Chat Application
milestones.outcome: Show competence with websockets, real‑time UI updates, and scaling basics.

tasks.title: Design data model for messages and rooms
tasks.description: Create tables for users, chat rooms, and messages with appropriate indexes.

tasks.title: Implement Socket.io server in Node
tasks.description: Set up a Socket.io server that broadcasts messages to room participants.

tasks.title: Build React chat UI with hooks
tasks.description: Create components for message list, input box, and online users using useState and useEffect.

tasks.title: Test real‑time flow locally
tasks.description: Run both client and server, send messages, and verify updates appear instantly.

tasks.title: Reflect on latency handling
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how you would handle network latency and reconnection.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, system design basics, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: System Design Basics
milestones.outcome: Explain core design concepts and evaluate trade‑offs for simple services.

tasks.title: Read System Design Primer on GitHub
tasks.description: Study the sections on scalability, load balancing, and caching.

tasks.title: Sketch architecture for chat app
tasks.description: Draw a diagram showing client, API server, websocket layer, and database.

tasks.title: Compare SQL vs NoSQL for messaging
tasks.description: Write a short comparison of using PostgreSQL versus MongoDB for chat storage.

tasks.title: Discuss design with a peer
tasks.description: Share your diagram in a developer forum and ask for feedback on bottlenecks.

milestones.title: Deployment & DevOps Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Deploy full‑stack apps reliably and monitor them in production.

tasks.title: Watch freeCodeCamp CI/CD tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the tutorial on setting up GitHub Actions for automated tests and deployment.

tasks.title: Configure Dockerfile for Node app
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile that builds and runs your Express API in a container.

tasks.title: Set up monitoring with Grafana
tasks.description: Deploy a basic Grafana dashboard to track CPU and response time of your app.

tasks.title: Reflect on deployment challenges
tasks.description: Note any issues you faced with environment variables or container networking.

milestones.title: Job/Client Readiness
milestones.outcome: Present a compelling portfolio and ace technical interviews.

tasks.title: Polish portfolio website on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Create a clean landing page that links to your SaaS and chat projects with screenshots.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories for each project
tasks.description: Write concise Situation‑Task‑Action‑Result narratives for interview talking points.

tasks.title: Solve 5 algorithm problems on LeetCode (JS)
tasks.description: Pick medium‑difficulty array or string challenges and solve them using TypeScript.

tasks.title: Mock technical interview with a friend
tasks.description: Run a 45‑minute pair‑programming session covering system design and coding.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and iterate
tasks.description: Update your portfolio or answers based on the mock interview insights.
